input.prompt: A single RimWorld game sprite of a building: a CLAWDRILL, a Red miners' helldiver drilling rig, seen from above at RimWorld's slight three-quarter top-down angle, as RimWorld draws its deep drill. A squat armoured tracked chassis with a small enclosed operator cab, and an enormous segmented drill head of serrated claw-like teeth pointing straight DOWN into the ground in the middle, hydraulic rams and thick cables, scuffed dark iron with rust-red paint and hazard stripes, rock dust. RimWorld art style: flat cel shading lit from the upper left, thick pure black outlines, muted colours, readable at small size. Whole machine in frame, centred, roughly square footprint. Plain flat pure white background, no text, no shadow, no ground
